### New Features

* **Proton Mail - Hide sidebar upselling:** add patch ([799b985](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/799b985465528fae922be42f8e39dec99f716497))

patches.name: Hide sidebar upselling
patches.description: Hides the 'Upgrade to Mail Plus' entry from the sidebar.

patches.name: Remove 'Sent from' signature
patches.description: Removes the 'Sent from Proton Mail mobile' signature from emails.

patches.name: Remove free accounts limit
patches.description: Removes the limit for maximum free accounts logged in.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks ad removal, light theme, custom images, list view types, quick ratings, and transparent widgets.
